reasons.text: The Old Town encompasses Zurich's Celtic and Roman settlement, medieval town and former palatinate, making it a central archaeological area.
reasons.quote: Zuerst als keltische Siedlung nachgewiesen, wurde der Lindenhof ab 15 v. Chr. zum römischen Militärstützpunkt.

reasons.text: The lower Lake Zurich basin contains prehistoric lakeside settlements, providing additional archaeological context.
reasons.quote: In so-called Archäologische Fenster (archaeological windows), the Department of City Planning shows treasures from Zurich’s past, such as the ruins of a Roman fort, the remains of prehistoric pile dwellings, and the Ehgraben sewer, which reveals how a medieval town dealt with its waste and sewage problems.

reasons.text: The site contains archaeological remains from Celtic, Roman and medieval periods, including the Roman settlement Turicum and medieval royal palace.
reasons.quote: Bereits die Kelten gründeten hier eine frühe befestigte Stadt (Oppidum).

reasons.text: The Lindenhof was the centre of a Roman settlement and later a Frankish royal palace.
reasons.quote: Später war er das Zentrum einer römischen Siedlung und wurde im 9. Jahrhundert zur fränkischen Pfalz.

reasons.text: The archaeological remains include the fourth-century Roman fortifications and ninth-century palace buildings.
reasons.quote: Die Ausgrabung am Westrand der Lindenhofterrasse – direkt an der Westmauer des Kastells aus dem 4. Jh. – reichte bei Abschluss in eine Tiefe von fünf Metern, wo sie die anstehende, letzteiszeitliche Moräne erreichte.

reasons.text: The archaeological remains of Roman thermal baths are visible at this location.
reasons.quote: In 1983, during renovation work on a toyshop, the remains of ancient Roman baths were discovered, thus putting Zürich's history in a new light.

reasons.text: The excavated baths can be viewed through a protective metal grating, with explanatory displays.
reasons.quote: The baths were excavated and can now be viewed around the clock through a metal grating.

reasons.text: The baths illustrate the importance of Roman Turicum as a trading and customs settlement.

reasons.text: This is a notable fountain in Zurich's historic city centre, next to Fraumünster Church.
reasons.quote: The fountain with a diameter of around 6 meters (20 ft) stands on the historic Münsterhof, directly next to the Fraumünster Church.

reasons.text: The fountain has a distinctive feature allowing wine to flow from one of its taps on special occasions.
reasons.quote: On special occasions, the fountain can be converted so that wine flows from one of its side taps.

reasons.text: The fountain is a historic cast-iron structure decorated with three winged lions.
reasons.quote: In 1877, this was replaced by an imposing cast-iron fountain guarded by three winged lions.

reasons.text: Its location has a historical connection to the city's stagecoach traffic and horses.
reasons.quote: The Zentralhof was once a hub for stagecoach traffic.

reasons.text: The fountain features a sculpture commemorating the legend of Zurich's courageous women.
reasons.quote: Die Figur von Gustav Siber (1864–1927) erinnert an die Legende der tapferen Zürcherinnen, die 1292 in Kampfmontur das Heer von Herzog Albrecht I. von Habsburg abschreckten, indem sie sich auf dem Lindenhof versammelten und so ein kampfkräftiges Heer vortäuschten.

reasons.text: The fountain is a documented feature of the historic Lindenhof public space.
